lastCompletedStory.title: Sidecar generic gate lifecycle: write+notify, poll+resolve+clear+flip

nextStoryContext: US-004 (in-progress-conflict gate) is the first CONCRETE consumer of the US-003 generic primitive shipped here. Two exported functions in src/supervisor/gate.ts do the heavy lifting: `writeGateAndNotify(filePath, {gate,options,context}, setPhaseFn, notifyFn)` (write side: clears a stale gate file first via removeGateFile, writes the fresh one with no `decision`, flips phase to 'awaiting-operator', pushes one notify line via formatGateNotifyLine) and `pollAndResolveGate(filePath, registry, setPhaseFn)` (poll side: reads leniently, RE-VALIDATES a populated `decision` against `gate.options` -- never trusts cam decide's own validation transitively -- looks up `registry[gate.gate]` (a `GateResolutionHandler = (gate: CamGate) => LoopPhase`), calls it, deletes the gate file, flips phase; an invalid decision or unregistered discriminator is left untouched for the next tick). US-004 must: (1) detect in-progress work when a plan is requested (per its AC1), (2) call writeGateAndNotify with gate:'in-progress-conflict', options: EXACTLY ['continue','ship','abandon'] (per its AC1 literal), before any issue selection/dispatch happens, and (3) register a handler for 'in-progress-conflict' into the SAME registry object that sidecar.ts's makeProductionGatePhaseFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts) builds -- that registry is currently `{}` (empty), built inline in makeProductionGatePhaseFn; US-004 will need to either thread handler-registration into that factory or extract the registry construction so both the plan-phase call site (write) and the gate-phase poll closure (resolve) share the identical object. The poll side is already fully wired into the sidecar's outer loop (loop.ts's runSidecarLoop gained a runGatePhaseFn option + an awaiting-operator branch, sibling of planning/shipping, positioned BEFORE the active!==true idle check for the same reason those two are). No production call site writes a gate yet (writeGateAndNotify is unused in sidecar.ts outside tests) -- that first call site is US-004's job.
